command:start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }'); base=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "cannot tell where this task branch started: no 'gnomish: task started' commit and no origin/main"; exit 1; }; oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$change/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $change/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$change"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$change/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $change/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

The enum already exists: `KeyboardKey` in constants/keyboard.ts (ENTER, ESCAPE, SPACE, ARROW_*), used by dayTrackKeys.ts, locationMenuKeys.ts and LocationSearchDialog.tsx. Use KeyboardKey.* here.

Traceability missing in changed production code. tasks.md says: "`Implements FR-X of add-wall-time-input-with-hint` in the JSDoc of new or changed production code". No mention of add-wall-time-input-with-hint in: presenter/presentZoneMoment.ts (adds `wallTimeInputLabel`, `wallTimeHint`, `findRowNoteOf`, the `cityLabel` subject and `wallClockNote` context; task 3.4, FR7/NFR-A2), presenter/dateBar.ts (`presentDateBar` switched to `formatWallClockTime`; task 3.2, NFR-P1), presenter/presentLocationRows.ts and presenter/presentHereEntry.ts (now pass `cityLabel`; task 3.4), views/shared/LocationList.tsx (new `onConfirmWallTime` prop; task 5.3) and views/cards/CardsView.tsx (wires `useWallTimeInput().confirmWallTime`; task 5.3, FR1/FR3). Add an `Implements FR… of add-wall-time-input-with-hint` line to each JSDoc.

The delta spec scenario "Names in both languages" (specs/time-selection/spec.md) has two rows: English `Enter time — Moscow, 10:30` and Russian `Ввести время — Москва, 10:30`. Task 3.4 also asks for a test of «Ввести время — Москва, 10:30». The executable scenario in time_selection_wall_time_input_e2e.feature:45-50 checks only Russian, and expects "Ввести время — Moscow, 10:30". presentZoneMoment.wallTime.test.ts:55 asserts the same "Moscow" text. The English row has no feature-level test, and the Russian text differs from the spec. Make the scenario cover both rows of the spec (a stored Russian label «Москва» for the Russian row), or correct the delta spec and task 3.4 to the stored-label behaviour the tests assume.

findings.message: Module boundary violation: packages/client/src/model/reduceWallTime.legacy.test.ts:3 imports `createLegacyZoneDateTimeFormat` from "@/lib/legacy/zoneShim", an internal file of the lib/legacy module. lib/legacy/index.ts only exports `type { LegacyZoneNames } from "./zoneShim"`, not this function. The acceptance criteria require "imports only through a module's `index.ts`", and .claude/rules/process-invariants.md says "Import only through `index.ts` of a module. Never import from internal files of a sibling module." It is the only import from outside lib/legacy/ that reaches into it. Fix: either export createLegacyZoneDateTimeFormat from lib/legacy/index.ts and import it from "@/lib/legacy", or reuse startOnOutdatedZoneData()/restoreZoneData() from test/features/browser_compatibility/steps/legacyZoneWorld.ts, as the change's BDD scenario 'A renamed zone on outdated zone data' does, instead of building a second copy of the engine stub.
